description: Independent benchmark authored from general medical knowledge, NOT sampled or derived from data/processed/data.json or any corpus content. Purpose: objective out-of-distribution evaluation, distinct from data/eval/medical_benchmark.json (which is corpus-derived and inflates retrieval scores). 48 in-scope questions across 18 medical categories + 12 adversarial/trap questions (fake drugs, fake diseases, impossible-certainty asks) to measure honest-failure rate instead of hallucination.
author_note: Authored by an LLM (Claude) from general medical knowledge, not a licensed physician. Recommend spot-check by a medical professional before treating results as ground truth.
